description: Decision rules learned by SAGEAgent's semantic memory in the paper's experiments (glioma cohort, nested 5x5 cross-validation). One rule set per pipeline, keyed outer_k/inner_m as in embedding/glioma/splits.json. Outcome statistics are those recorded while the rules were learned. Evaluate with: python evaluate.py --rules rules/glioma.json --no-episodic
